enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Sleeps. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket up. Sleeps. Stretches legs. Sleeps. Turns to back. Sleeps. Wakes up. Opens eyes. Yawns. Stretches arms. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face with cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Greets Member 1: 'Good morning.' Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Takes out bread from cabinet. Places bread in toaster. Turns on kettle. Cracks eggs into bowl. Pours egg mixture into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off induction cooker. Takes out toast. Places toast and eggs on plates. Pours tea into cups. Sits at table with Member 1. Eats breakfast. Talks with Member 1: 'Did you sleep well?' Turns off kitchen light. Leaves kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Takes out socks. Takes out underwear. Closes wardrobe. Puts on underwear. Puts on socks. Puts on pants. Puts on shirt. Looks in mirror. Brushes hair. Opens bag. Places laptop in bag. Places notebook in bag. Places pen in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Leaves bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to work by walking and public transport together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Leaves house with Member 1. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Talks with Member 1: 'The weather is nice today.' Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down next to Member 1. Continues talking with Member 1. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks with Member 1 to office building. Says goodbye to Member 1: 'See you tonight.' Enters office building. Walks to office. Opens office door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at arts organization office on administrative tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Enters password. Opens email client. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Returns to desk. Makes phone calls. Types documents. Prints documents. Files documents. Organizes desk. Takes a break. Drinks water. Continues working. Saves files.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking lunch break at a nearby cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafe. Enters cafe. Approaches counter. Orders sandwich and coffee. Pays cashier. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Drinks coffee. Checks phone. Finishes meal. Clears table. Exits cafe. Walks back to office. Enters office building. Walks to desk. Sits down.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work at arts organization office
enriched_activities.desc: Opens computer. Reviews project files. Edits documents. Makes phone calls. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Collaborates with colleagues. Sends emails. Prints materials. Organizes files. Takes a break. Drinks coffee. Resumes work. Updates spreadsheet. Prepares presentation. Saves files. Shuts down computer. Organizes desk.

Leaves office. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house. Removes shoes. Greets Member 1: 'I'm home.' Walks to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Greets Member 1: 'What's for dinner?' Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds vegetables and meat. Stir-fries. Places food on plates. Sits at table with Member 1. Eats dinner. Talks with Member 1: 'How was your day?' Finishes eating. Picks up plates. Places plates in dishwasher. Turns off kitchen light. Leaves kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Sits on sofa with Member 1. Picks up remote control. Turns on TV. Browses channels. Selects a movie. Watches TV. Talks with Member 1 about the movie. Adjusts volume. Continues watching. Laughs. Changes channel during commercial. Watches more. Turns off TV. Stands up. Says goodnight to Member 1. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration projects using computer and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Enters Bedroom 2. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Opens illustration software. Creates new canvas. Sketches with stylus. Refines lines. Adds colors. Adjusts layers. Saves file. Takes a break. Stretches. Drinks water. Resumes work. Edits details. Saves final file. Shuts down computer. Turns off desk lamp. Leaves desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking evening shower and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Enters Bedroom 2. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Sets alarm on phone. Places phone on nightstand. Turns off desk lamp. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Remains still. Sleeps.
